summary: Recent discussions cover a new external lookup join strategy, an AI code review bot for pull requests, and proposals to add an ADBC data source and a language‑agnostic UDF protocol. Other topics include a fix for Istio strict mTLS communication failures and a vote on Spark 4.2.1 RC1.

highlights.text: Proposed external lookup join strategy to perform on‑demand lookups against external storage, reducing latency for stream joins
Trial AI code review bot using Claude that posts advisory comments on new or updated Spark pull requests

sources.title: [DISCUSS] Automated AI code review on new Spark PRs (trial)

highlights.text: Proposal to add a built‑in ADBC data source for columnar Arrow reads and writes, complementing the existing JDBC source
Language‑agnostic UDF protocol to enable user‑defined functions in any language via external workers, supporting Spark Connect

sources.title: SPIP: Language-agnostic UDF Protocol for Spark
